title: DAY 3 — LESSON 5: GIVING AND RECEIVING INSTRUCTIONS

questions.prompt: What makes a workplace instruction effective?
options: Speaking loudly so the employee obeys
Clearly communicating the task, responsibility, requirements and deadline
Assuming the employee already knows everything

questions.prompt: You receive an instruction you do not understand. What should you do?
Two people give you conflicting work instructions. What is the best response?
options: Explain the conflict and seek clarification of priorities

questions.prompt: A task is delayed because required supplies are unavailable. What should the employee do?
options: Say nothing until the deadline passes
Report the difficulty promptly and seek guidance

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes responsible execution of instructions?
options: Understanding the task, completing it appropriately and communicating the outcome
Saying 'okay' even when the task is unclear
Completing only the easiest part of the task
